046064: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_evaluate_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, CIrConstantValue* result_out)
046065: {
046066:     if (!builder->queries)
046067:     {
046068:         return false;
046069:     }
046070:     CIrQueryMachine* machine = builder->queries;
046071:     CIrQueryResume* resume = machine->resumes + (machine->frame_count - 1);
046072:     u32 value_start = resume->valid ? resume->value_start : machine->value_count;
046073:     u32 operator_start = resume->valid ? resume->operator_start : machine->operator_count;
046074:     bool result = c_ir_constant_evaluate_impl(builder, start, end, result_out, value_start, operator_start, resume);
046075:     // A pending request means this frame is suspended with its stack regions
046076:     // reserved for the sub-query to build above; every other exit releases
046077:     // them.
046078:     if (!machine->has_request)
046079:     {
046080:         machine->value_count = value_start;
046081:         machine->operator_count = operator_start;
046082:     }
046083:     return result;
046084: }
046085: 
046086: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_evaluate(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, CIrConstantValue* result_out)
046087: {
046088:     CIrQueryFrame result = {0};
046089:     if (!c_ir_query_execute(builder, (CIrQueryFrame){.start = start, .end = end, .kind = C_IR_QUERY_FRAME_CONSTANT}, &result) || !result.success)
046090:     {
046091:         return false;
046092:     }
046093:     *result_out = result.constant;
046094:     return true;
046095: }
